conventions.false_alerts: Notice keys counted once at first eligibility, at events and scheduler wakeups.
conventions.missed_breaches_end: Existing scorer's breach false negatives at end of ticket.
conventions.status_accuracy: Existing scorer's end status on matched promises; claimed counts as done.
conventions.A: No close or claim proposed on the fulfilment evidence.
conventions.B: Proposal aimed at the intended promise did not take effect.
conventions.C: Fulfilment evidence led to a close or claim on another target.
conventions.D: A planted restatement opened another promise row.
conventions.E: Alert fired outside the window of the gold deadline.
conventions.claim_only: The evidence was recorded as the debtor's claim and triggered a check.
conventions.unplanted: The alert concerns an unmatched promise outside a planted restatement.

writer_label_noise.effect: The rewrite added an undated notification promise. The scorer counted it as an extra.
